dis.text: Prahv, the Azorius city containing the senate chamber, is where Modar Bejiri receives his field hussar's brooch and later hands it over, requesting an emergency writ of arrest for himself, because the Guildpact forbids direct action against a guild member without a warrant.
The Parhelion reappears over Ravnica on a collision course with Prahv as the Azorius, Boros and Selesnya become embroiled in a scandal over Feather, who turned herself in.
Augustin reveals that he took control of the captured Szadek, but Szadek's ghost kills Augustin IV just before the Parhelion explodes and levels Prahv.
